exports.title: The core loop
exports.lede: A run changes one focused surface, evaluates the challenger against the champion, then writes memory for the next loop.
exports.placement: README How It Works anchor; blog/social overview

exports.title: Ontology map
exports.lede: Research becomes a shared map of users, tasks, quality, failure modes, and evaluation vocabulary.
exports.placement: README intro after the ontology paragraph; social explainer

exports.title: Deconstruction map
exports.lede: The current champion is mapped into testable surfaces, each carrying evidence, risk, and a measurement plan.
exports.placement: docs/HOW_IT_WORKS deconstruction section; technical social post

exports.title: Control vs treatment
exports.lede: The champion stays fixed while one challenger tests a focused mutation under the same prompts and criteria.

exports.title: Cold-start duel
exports.lede: Scratch projects start with two independently planned candidates because there is no champion control yet.
exports.placement: README How It Works scratch-run section

exports.title: Experiment plan
exports.lede: The manager chooses what changes, what stays fixed, and what evidence should prove or disprove the hypothesis.
exports.placement: README next-loop plan or UI walkthrough

exports.title: Preflight review gate
exports.lede: Candidates must pass package, safety, leakage, and experiment-fidelity checks before evaluation.

exports.title: Prompt-level evidence stack
exports.lede: Every promotion can point back to prompt text, candidate outputs, criterion scores, and judge rationale.

exports.title: Promotion policy gate
exports.lede: Skill RSI blocks flashy wins that fail thresholds, regress stable prompts, or lack enough evidence.
exports.placement: docs/HOW_IT_WORKS promotion section; social technical post

exports.title: History as memory
exports.lede: Detailed artifacts and compact history make each loop better informed than the last.
exports.placement: README history screenshot section; social proof post

exports.title: Artifact contract
exports.lede: The selected output type controls what prompts can ask for and what judges are allowed to score.

exports.title: Operator surfaces
exports.lede: The UI, CLI, and Codex plugin all operate the same underlying run loop and project store.
exports.placement: README Codex Plugin and Local UI sections
